accountHandling: Use a dedicated project-scoped reviewer account. Deliver credentials through the submission portal only. Never reuse the operator account.

positive.prompt: Get started in my new project on Divblox.
positive.expected: Ask which authorized project and what the user wants to build; present a concise staged plan.

positive.prompt: Find the “MCP production validation — workflows” requirement and summarize it.
positive.expected: Resolve its title within the selected project; summarize retrieved content without inventing omitted data.

positive.prompt: Create a demo requirement for an appointment booking app.
positive.expected: Use approved project creation permission; return the created title only after confirmed success.

positive.prompt: Create and estimate tickets for this requirement, then plan them as tasks.
positive.expected: Review the plan, use linked tickets and planning dates/assignments, preserving ticket links.

positive.prompt: Show work in progress and recently completed tickets, with their timeline.
positive.expected: Use configured tracking lists and recorded event/history data; disclose missing timestamps or incomplete results.

negative.prompt: Create a ticket with read-only project consent.
negative.expected: Friendly permission denial; no upstream mutation.

negative.prompt: Change a record belonging to a project I did not select.
negative.expected: Deny the action without disclosing foreign project contents.

negative.prompt: Retry the same confirmed write, then change its content using the same request key.
negative.expected: Return the cached result for an identical request; reject conflicting content without dispatch.

knownLimits: Separate authorization may be required for creation and workflow edits.
A client may require catalog refresh after tool changes.
Never treat an unknown write outcome as success.
Use only dedicated reviewer fixtures for destructive tests.
A list with multiple tracking milestones can produce an ambiguous aggregate progress state and no completion percentage; report the individual recorded milestones.
evidenceScope: Production SDK checks verified the underlying isolated requirement, ticket, checklist, planning, movement and history workflows. These exact model-generated prompts have not been rerun under the reviewer account.
